subject: Audit logs & data access - follow-up and evidence request
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@fincobank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Turner <sam.turner@fincobank.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Audit logs / access evidence (post-call)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — really helpful. As we discussed on the call, the procurement and security teams need sample audit evidence showing data access (who accessed what/when) and the export formats you can provide for review. Specifically the questions from our InfoSec folks: 

- What fields are included in your access logs? (user id, service, resource id, action, timestamp, source IP, request id, etc.)
- Do logs contain any PII or are identifiers hashed/redacted?
- What is your default retention period for audit logs and can this be extended for enterprise contracts?
- Can you produce an export for a specific timeframe (e.g., 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31) and the format (CSV/JSON/Parquet)?
- How will evidence be delivered (S3 presigned, secure share, encrypted archive)?

KPMG will also want a short description of chain-of-custody for the export. Can you provide a sample (or redacted) extract and a short doc describing retention and export procedures?

Appreciate if you can loop in whoever on your side will own the export and security details. Procurement timeline is tight — ideally we get initial evidence within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Elena
Senior IT Risk Manager
FinCo Bank

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@fincobank.com>
Cc: Sam Turner <sam.turner@fincobank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Audit logs / access evidence (post-call)

Hi Elena — great to connect earlier. Thanks for the clear list; below are high-level answers and next steps. I’ve attached a small audit_log_template.csv and a short export_instructions.md to this email as a starting point.

High-level answers:
- Log fields: timestamp (ISO8601), internal_user_id (hashed), external_principal (email, redacted), model_id, route, resource_id, action (read/write/export), request_id, response_size_tokens, source_ip (last octet redacted), region, and agent.
- PII handling: We do not log user plaintext PII. Internal_user_id and other identifiers can be hashed or replaced with opaque IDs for exports. We can apply additional redaction on request.
- Retention: Hosted default is 90 days for detailed access logs. Dedicated/Private deployments can support customizable retention (90d/1yr/7yrs) as part of contract terms.
- Export formats: CSV and JSONL are standard; Parquet available on request (used for large bulk exports).
- Delivery: We can deliver via encrypted S3 (pre-signed, short TTL) or via a secure share link to a vetted SFTP/Box location. Deliveries are encrypted at rest and in transit; we can provide SHA256 checksums for chain-of-custody.

Next steps (timeline):
- Aditya (engineering) will produce a redacted extract for 2026-05-01 -> 2026-05-31 in CSV and JSONL and upload to the secure folder within 48 hours.
- Marissa/Ben (CS/Sales) will provide the DPA/DPA redlines and coordinate access for KPMG.
- I’ll share a short writeup of our retention policy and export procedure (chain-of-custody).

Attachments: audit_log_template.csv (sample schema), export_instructions.md (short procedure).

If you prefer a specific column set / extra redaction please let us know and we’ll adjust.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0189

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up: Audit logs / access evidence (FinCo) — action items

Team — forwarding FinCo request and tagging owners. Quick actions below: 

Action items:
- Aditya: Export redacted user access logs for 2026-05-01 -> 2026-05-31. Required columns per Elena: timestamp, internal_user_id (hashed), action, resource_id, model_id, request_id, source_ip (redacted), region. Deliver CSV + JSONL. Please include SHA256 checksum and a short MD5 for verification. Upload to secure Drive folder (link below) or provide presigned S3 link. ETA 48 hours.
- Marissa: Coordinate with FinCo security and KPMG contact for DPA redlines and chain-of-custody questions. Provide sample SOC2 artifact if requested.
- Ben: Help with procurement escalation if longer retention is required (we can scope Dedicated).

Secure folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d5e6f
Attached: audit_log_template.csv (schema), export_instructions.md

Thanks — please acknowledge and confirm timelines.

-Jordan

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Follow-up: Audit logs / access evidence (FinCo) — action items

Acknowledged. I’ll run the export job and produce both CSV and JSONL exports. Implementation notes: 

- Script will pull the access_logs table and apply the following transformations: replace internal_user_id with HMAC_SHA256(op_id, salt), mask source_ip to last octet, drop any free-text request metadata that may contain PII.
- Output schemas will match audit_log_template.csv; JSONL will include the same fields per line.
- Delivery: upload encrypted tar.gz to the secure Drive folder and post a presigned S3 link in the folder for KPMG. Files will be AES-256 encrypted with a password we will share via vendor-verified channel. I will also generate SHA256 checksums and an export_manifest.txt with timings and the query used (for chain-of-custody).
- ETA: I expect first exports within ~36 hours (by 2026-06-04T20:00:00Z). If procurement needs faster, I can prioritize a smaller sample first (e.g., 5 days).

Will update the thread when upload completes.

- Aditya
Senior Software Engineer, Infra
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@fincobank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Turner <sam.turner@fincobank.com>, KPMG Audit Team <kpmg.audit@kpmg.com>
Date: 2026-06-04T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Audit logs / access evidence (post-call)

Thanks Jordan and team — that all sounds good. KPMG will review the export and the manifest once available. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you confirm the geographic location where the logs are stored for FinCo? We need to note whether the primary copy resides in US or EU.
2) Please provide a contact for legal to discuss a DPA (our legal will send redlines).

If Aditya can upload a small 5-day sample first, that would be perfect for our procurement timeline.

Best,
Elena

P.S. Sam — looping you since you were on the call and procurement may want the sample today if possible.
